name: Aurelian
title: Lucius Domitius Aurelianus
summary: Aurelian was a Roman emperor from 270 to 275 during the Crisis of the Third Century. During his reign, he won an unprecedented series of military victories which reunited the Roman Empire after it had nearly disintegrated under the pressure of barbarian invasions and internal revolts. For his success in restoring the Empire's territorial integrity, Aurelian was honored with the title Restitutor Orbis.
notes: Reign: c. 5 years and 3 months. Aurelian's reunification ended the Crisis of the Third Century's fragmentation. His walls around Rome remained the city's defensive circuit for centuries. | Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aurelian
